patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — 8x8 and OpenPhone share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

8x8 and OpenPhone share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose 8x8 only if your buying job matches “Global UCaaS + contact-centre platform (8x8 Work / X Series) — Work X2 research floor ~$24” rather than OpenPhone's shape. Choose OpenPhone only if your buying job matches “Modern SMB shared business phone (also branded Quo) with shared numbers, SMS and Sona AI —” rather than 8x8's shape. Workflow advantage: 8x8 leans contact-center; OpenPhone leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — 8x8 and OpenPhone share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: 8x8 is Global UCaaS + contact-centre platform (8x8 Work / X Series) — Work X2 research floor ~$24/user/month annual; CC tiers custom/higher.; OpenPhone is Modern SMB shared business phone (also branded Quo) with shared numbers, SMS and Sona AI — Starter from $15/user/month annual..
- Company-size focus: 8x8 (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs OpenPhone (solo, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: 8x8-leaning contact-center vs OpenPhone-leaning —.
- Researched limits: 8x8 — Published seat floors are medium confidence — first-party pricing often bot/quote gated; OpenPhone — US/Canada-centric calling footprint — not a global UCaaS carrier story.

Limitations — 8x8: Published seat floors are medium confidence — first-party pricing often bot/quote gated; Mandatory regulatory/service fees frequently sit on top of list seats; OpenPhone: US/Canada-centric calling footprint — not a global UCaaS carrier story; Phone menus, automatic recording and deeper CRM require Business or above.
